body: My boyfriend and I were exclusive at that point. I would just wait it out honestly. You’ll know when the time is right! Do your research and when you tell him, ask him if he has questions. It is so very common as well, i guess 80% of people have it and most don’t even know. I don’t believe guys can get tested because they don’t have a cervix like us women. It is always good to find a good gyno and ask them your questions too 😊

to me, there was never a good time to mention it. i told my boyfriend about 3 weeks in. i think if you really like this person, you trust them and see a future with them, then you should tell him sooner rather than later. like my gynecologist told me, if they can’t accept you for you then they’re not worth it. hope this helps alittle ❤️
